title: A safe night's rest

previousScene.summary: Wren welcomed the traveler and showed them the yard chest.

setting.mapIntent: The player returns to a home room with a visible bed and chooses to sleep; exact room geometry is for the builder to author and validate.
placementConstraints: The bed must be reachable and interactable
The sleep interaction must not trigger accidentally on entering the room

uses.purpose: Reference the available player motion art; it does not provide a verified lying-down or wake-up animation.
If an explanatory line is used, show it through the current manually advanced dialogue UI.

beats.intent: Player deliberately interacts with the bed to sleep.
Show the character settling into bed and waking at morning; do not imply these poses already exist.
After sleeping, grant a configurable temporary party benefit that lasts for a clearly defined number of battles.
beats.expectedResult: The benefit survives save/reload, decrements only under its stated encounter rule, and cannot stack ambiguously.

requirements.description: A deliberate bed interaction that sequences sleep/wake and safely cancels or retries if interrupted.
Player sleep and wake poses aligned with the existing character sprite and foot/body anchors.
A configurable party effect with an explicit encounter counter, stacking/replacement rule, save migration, and flee/loss counting semantics.

completion: Sleeping is optional, can be interrupted safely, and grants only the documented temporary benefit. Until the listed mechanics/art are implemented, this script is a proposal and must not be compiled or described as playable.

canonicalFacts.statement: Healer Wren welcomes travelers and keeps supplies in the yard chest.

pendingThreads: The player may ask Wren about the road in a later scene.
